headline: MW4 Kill Block: a map that keeps changing
title: Modern Warfare 4 Kill Block | The Map With 500 Plus Layouts | Call of Duty News
video_script: Modern Warfare four has a map unlike any other, called Kill Block. Its layout keeps changing as the match goes on, and it has more than five hundred possible configurations. It is set in a training facility, so no two fights feel the same. Have you played Kill Block yet? Comment below!
description: Kill Block in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a training-facility map whose layout changes during the match, with more than 500 possible configurations.
